name: What is the first step to take after flood damage occurs in my home?

mainEntity.name: What is the first step to take after flood damage occurs in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately after a flood, your priority should be safety. Ensure the power is off before entering flooded areas. Document the damage with photos and videos for insurance purposes. Contact a professional flood damage cleanup service like First To Respond Restoration as soon as possible. Swift action minimizes further damage, prevents mold growth, and helps in a quicker restoration process. Our team can assess the extent of the damage and begin water extraction and drying procedures.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize safety, turn off power, document damage for insurance, and contact a professional restoration service like First To Respond Restoration immediately.
